name: MHD Filaments
desc: Magnetic field lines frozen into a moving plasma, dragged and stretched wherever the fluid goes until anti-parallel bundles are crushed together into blade-thin current sheets that finally cut and re-splice — reconnection — flinging the ropes apart to be stirred and crushed again; as luminous filaments threading a dim plasma, a signed current-sheet map, a solar EUV coronal plate, brushed ink contours, or spectral false-color.

energy.doc: field strength — how hard the Lorentz force fights back, plus field-line count and glow (the master knob)

scale.doc: flux-rope size — from a fine tangle of small ropes to a few vast lobes

speed.doc: time rate (0.2 still creeps and reconnects)

density.doc: COUNT of flux ropes — how often fresh rope is injected into the tangle

eta.doc: resistivity — how readily the plasma lets field lines cut and re-splice: low keeps the field frozen in and sheets thin and violent, high reconnects lazily and smooths everything

hue.doc: hue of the field lines (the plasma takes the complement)

x.doc: center of the flux-injection zone across the frame

y.doc: center of the flux-injection zone down the frame

style.doc: aesthetic: luminous field lines through a dim plasma / abstracted signed current map where only the reconnecting sheets exist / solar EUV coronal plate with detector grain / brushed sumi contours on paper / spectral false-color

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the background field shear and rope placement/timing
